Minutes from an earnest fortnight
The planning crew gathered to discuss quiet areas and to keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk running with care and steady attention.

Hugo Vega, Anika Mendes, and Roxie were present, along with the senior coordinator and the ground lead. The team reviewed routine support for passengers traveling with animals between skyports and confirmed that calm handling remains central to every handoff.

The cabin team reported that animals were settling well when carriers were placed with patience and checked again during flight. The ground team also noted that careful movement between services continued to reduce stress and helped keep each journey smooth for travelers and pets alike.

Attention then turned to desk messages, document updates, and the value of clear wording for families making plans through Aurelia Skyways. The group agreed that warm replies, gentle reminders, and consistent records support confidence at every stage of travel.

The meeting ended with thanks for the steady work and thoughtful care shown across the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
